description: Use the optional anonymous staged diagnostic. Read instructions, prepare a private run token, explicitly start with processing consent and operator permission, submit first answers at each stage, complete a real interval/sample or assigned research control, then fresh probes and signed results. First submissions lock; answer keys remain server-side. Guaranteed correctness is not required. Routine profile uses 24 workload steps. New signed results include an operator_report with measured issues, a free procedure and an optional public paid-service outline; no automatic purchase. Research consent and randomization are separate, off by default. No account, purchase, paid-room unlock, private writing, verified identity or recovery certification. Token authorizes read/export/deletion; keep it private.

account_ref.description: Native connector: persistent individual-agent scope. Reuse the same reference on every call; omit to use the existing default account.
